title: Problem
问题
html: Long reasoning traces are not simple linear chains: they contain branching ideas, revisits, dead ends, and dependencies. Existing reward models often judge only the final answer or compress the entire trace into one opaque score, leaving no unified definition of reasoning quality. The paper asks how to characterize efficient and effective reasoning at both macro and micro levels, evaluate complex trace structure, and turn those evaluations into signals for selection and reinforcement learning.
长推理轨迹并非简单线性链，而包含分支、回溯、死路和依赖关系。现有奖励模型常只判断最终答案，或把整条轨迹压缩为不透明总分，缺少统一的推理质量定义。论文研究如何从宏观与微观层面描述推理的效率和有效性，如何评价复杂轨迹结构，并把评价信号用于推理选择和强化学习优化。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper introduces the ME² principle for reasoning quality, represents traces as directed acyclic graphs, constructs TRM-Preference, and trains a Thinking Reward Model. Pairwise feedback is based on structured reasoning quality rather than answer correctness alone. The resulting reward can rank completed traces for test-time selection and guide RL training. The main contribution is a unified chain from characterization to dataset, evaluator, and optimization, with the reasoning DAG as the common representation.
论文提出用于描述推理质量的 ME² 原则，将推理轨迹表示为有向无环图，构建 TRM-Preference，并训练 Thinking Reward Model。偏好反馈依据结构化推理质量，而非仅看答案正确性。得到的奖励既可在测试时对完整轨迹排序，也可用于强化学习。核心贡献是把质量定义、数据集、评价器和优化统一为一条链，并以 reasoning DAG 作为共同表示。

title: Method
方法
html: The method parses or transforms reasoning traces into DAGs whose nodes and edges represent reasoning units and dependencies. ME² evaluates macro- and micro-level efficiency and effectiveness, enabling pairwise comparison of traces with different structure. These comparisons form TRM-Preference and supervise a Thinking Reward Model. At inference, several candidate traces are scored and the highest-reward trace is selected. During training, thinking rewards are combined with task signals in RL so the model is encouraged to produce traces that are both useful and structurally efficient.

方法把推理轨迹解析或转换为 DAG，其中节点和边表示推理单元及依赖。ME² 从宏观与微观层面评价效率和有效性，使结构不同的轨迹能够成对比较；这些比较形成 TRM-Preference，并监督 Thinking Reward Model。推理时，模型生成多条候选轨迹，由 TRM 评分后选择最高奖励者；训练时，thinking reward 与任务信号结合进入 RL，鼓励模型生成既有用又结构高效的推理。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper evaluates both test-time selection and RL optimization across diverse tasks. Selecting traces with the learned reward improves outcomes by as much as 19.3%, while adding thinking reward during RL yields gains up to 3.9%. Testing both uses is important because it shows the model is not only correlated with existing good answers but can also provide an actionable training signal. Dataset and model release further supports inspection. The evidence applies to the included trace parser, tasks, and reward definitions, not to an objective universal measure of thought.
论文在多类任务上同时评测测试时选择与 RL 优化。使用学习到的奖励选择轨迹，最终结果最高提升 19.3%；在 RL 中加入 thinking reward，性能最高提升 3.9%。同时验证两种用途很重要，因为它说明模型不仅与已有优质答案相关，还能提供可执行训练信号。数据和模型开放也便于审计。证据适用于所用轨迹解析器、任务和质量定义，但不能把 TRM 分数视为对“思考质量”的客观普遍度量。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior reasoning rewards focus on final correctness, step labels, or a linear sequence. This paper changes the representation to a DAG and evaluates both local reasoning units and global structure under one ME² framework. Its novelty is the structural feedback contract and its end-to-end use in preference-data construction, reward modeling, test-time selection, and RL. DAGs and pairwise reward models are not individually new; the contribution is adapting them to implicitly structured long reasoning and validating both inference and training use.
以往推理奖励主要关注最终正确性、逐步标签或线性序列。本文把表示改为 DAG，并在统一 ME² 框架下同时评价局部推理单元与整体结构。其新意是结构化反馈契约，以及从偏好数据构造、奖励建模到测试时选择和 RL 的端到端使用。DAG 与成对奖励模型单独来看并非新技术，真正贡献是将其适配隐式结构复杂的长推理，并同时验证推理和训练用途。

title: Limitations
局限
html: DAG construction requires reliable segmentation and dependency inference; parser errors can become reward errors. ME² embeds normative assumptions about when repetition, branching, or length is efficient, although some tasks legitimately require exploration. Synthetic or model-labeled preferences may favor tidy traces over faithfully representing exploratory reasoning that is not exposed in the released record. Reported gains also depend on candidate diversity and RL reward weighting. Reuse should audit graph extraction, compare with answer-only rewards, and test cases where long exploratory reasoning is necessary rather than wasteful.
DAG 构造依赖可靠的步骤切分和依赖推断，解析错误会直接变成奖励错误。ME² 对重复、分支和长度何时属于高效包含规范性假设，但某些任务确实需要探索。合成或模型标注偏好可能偏爱整洁轨迹，却不一定更忠实。结果还依赖候选多样性和 RL 奖励权重。复用时应审计图提取、与答案级奖励比较，并专门测试必须进行长探索的任务，而不能一律把冗长视为低质量。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: TRM-Preference can train a reasoning-quality ranker, while the TRM can rerank sampled solutions or supply auxiliary reward in RL. The DAG representation is also useful for error analysis, such as identifying redundant branches or unsupported dependencies. Researchers can compare answer-correct traces that differ structurally, isolating process quality from outcome. The method is less suitable when traces are unavailable, deliberately compressed, or not faithfully related to model computation, and it should not replace executable correctness checks.
TRM-Preference 可用于训练推理质量排序器，TRM 则可重排采样解答或在 RL 中提供辅助奖励。DAG 表示还适合错误分析，例如识别冗余分支和无依据依赖。研究者可比较最终答案都正确但结构不同的轨迹，从而把过程质量与结果分离。当轨迹不可得、被刻意压缩或不能忠实反映模型计算时，该方法适用性较低，也不应替代可执行正确性检查。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The paper defines reasoning quality with ME², represents traces as DAGs, builds TRM-Preference, and trains a Thinking Reward Model. The reward yields up to 19.3% improvement through test-time selection and up to 3.9% during RL. Its value is a common structured signal usable at both inference and training. The required audit is DAG validity: if segmentation or dependency edges are wrong, the reward’s apparent process awareness may be an artifact of the parser.
论文以 ME² 定义推理质量，把轨迹表示为 DAG，构建 TRM-Preference 并训练 Thinking Reward Model。该奖励用于测试时选择最高提升 19.3%，用于 RL 最高提升 3.9%。其价值是同一结构化信号可同时服务推理与训练。最关键审计是 DAG 有效性：如果步骤切分或依赖边错误，奖励模型看似具备的过程理解可能只是解析器造成的假象。
